challenges.name: stable-route-report
challenges.title: A route report in the same order every day
challenges.description: The audit compares today's route report with yesterday's, and a HashMap printed the routes in a different order on every run. Write group_by_route, which groups the scans into a HashMap from route to its parcel ids (sorted, each id once, because scanners sometimes read a parcel twice), ranking, which returns (route, count) pairs with the busiest route first and ties in A-Z order of the route, and top, which returns the first k entries without panicking when there are fewer than k. The test runner prints the top routes with their parcel ids, the total number of parcels and the number of double reads.
